## Analytical and technical expertise

**Organic geochemistry:** lipid extraction, saponification, derivatization, silica-gel and AgNO₃-silica chromatography, urea adduction; GC-FID, GC-MS, and GC-IRMS for compound-specific δ¹³C and δ²H measurements.

**Paleolimnology and fieldwork:** lake-sediment coring, core description and sub-sampling, vegetation and soil sampling, bulk organic matter analysis, macrofossil picking, radiocarbon and ²¹⁰Pb/¹³⁷Cs geochronology, Bayesian age–depth modelling, diatom preparation, and XRF core scanning.

**Software:** R, Grapher, QGIS/ArcGIS, Adobe Illustrator, PAST, and Fiji/ImageJ.

**Languages:** Portuguese (native), English and Spanish (fluent), Italian and German (basic, in progress).
